Coverage_Description: Landlord cover for household contents at insured premises (Plan 1 up to HK$500,000; Plan 2 up to HK$1,500,000, with per-item limits), loss of rent up to HK$120,000/240,000 (max 6 months), property owner legal liability up to HK$10,000,000 per policy year, and opti
pricing: Annual premium (basic): HK$590-800 (Plan 1) or HK$840-1,400 (Plan 2), depending on floor-area band; optional building structure premium = sum insured × 0.07% (with basic cover) or × 0.09% (without basic cover).
customer requirement: Applicant must be the owner of the insured premises; policy starts only after company acceptance and premium payment
price structure: Yearly premium by plan tier and gross/saleable floor area; optional building-structure cover priced as a percentage of declared sum insured (minimum HK$500,000)
additional informations: Policy term is 1 year with automatic yearly renewal (subject to underwriting); loyalty bonus adds HK$50,000 household-contents limit per renewal up to HK$200,000; excess generally HK$250, with specific higher excess rules for water/wallpaper and HK$3,000 for building-structure non-fire/explosion losses
